author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.35 shipped: Battery ladder floor, trimmed room menu, pure sensor getters, zone/house wording
summary: Battery ladder floor, trimmed room menu, pure sensor getters, zone/house wording
why: Blitz batch of four independently reviewed changes: the battery drain-target ladder had a legal slider combination that could command a reserve below the floor (fixed at its single seam, peak-buffer kept detect-only); the room dialog is the core of URA and was a power-user mess, so menus are trimmed by room type with HA Advanced mode for tuning; three sensor getters spawned work on every read; zone/house dialogs showed raw key names.
implications: Shipped HOUSE-DIALOGS-CLEANUP-1 at v5.103.35; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.35.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: A threshold_ladder_violation for the peak-buffer invariant -> build the parked D2; operator feedback that a trimmed room hides something needed -> revisit the room-type step map.

refs.release_notes: Drain targets never command a reserve below the floor; room settings trimmed by room type with Simple/Advanced; three sensors stop starting work on every read; zone and house dialogs get plain labels. See README_v5.103.35.
